## Details
### **SW-REQ-SYS-001** — Raw Sensor Logging to SD Card

- **Description:** The FSW shall log all raw sensor measurements to the SD card during the mission.
- **Rationale:** FT1 mission role requires preservation of raw sensor data for post-flight analysis and Trick simulation anchoring.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** None
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SYS-002** — Live In-Flight Navigation Estimation

- **Description:** The FSW shall execute a live navigation algorithm in flight to estimate and propagate nav state.
- **Rationale:** FT1 is a nav-evaluation flight; the navigation algorithm must run on flight hardware in real time.
- **Verification Method:** Demonstration
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** None
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SYS-003** — Live Telemetry Downlink Over LoRa

- **Description:** The FSW shall transmit live telemetry over the LoRa radio during the mission.
- **Rationale:** FT1 requires real-time ground visibility into vehicle state and recovery beaconing post-landing.
- **Verification Method:** Demonstration
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** None
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SYS-004** — No Actuation on FT1

- **Description:** The FSW shall not command any vehicle actuator during the FT1 mission.
- **Rationale:** FT1 scope is nav evaluation and sim anchoring; actuation is explicitly out of scope.
- **Verification Method:** Inspection
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** None
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SYS-005** — IMU Sample Rate

- **Description:** The FSW shall sample the IMU at 200 Hz throughout the mission.
- **Rationale:** PM-fixed IMU rate to bound boost-phase motion (~13 G, 500 ms) and support nav at 100 Hz.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** None
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SYS-006** — IMU Accelerometer Range

- **Description:** The FSW shall configure the IMU accelerometer range to plus or minus 16 G.
- **Rationale:** Flight envelope reaches 13 G; 16 G range provides margin without saturation during boost.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** None
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SYS-007** — IMU Gyroscope Range

- **Description:** The FSW shall configure the IMU gyroscope range to plus or minus 2000 degrees per second.
- **Rationale:** Maximum rotation rate envelope for FT1; 2000 dps avoids saturation during boost and recovery.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** None
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SYS-008** — Altimeter Sample Rate

- **Description:** The FSW shall sample the barometric altimeter at 20 Hz throughout the mission.
- **Rationale:** PM-fixed rate sufficient for apogee detection (~600 m) and nav baro fusion at 20 Hz cadence.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** None
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SYS-009** — GPS Sample Rate

- **Description:** The FSW shall sample the GPS receiver at 5 Hz throughout the mission.
- **Rationale:** PM-fixed GPS rate matches FGPMMOPA6H capability and supports horizontal nav bounding.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** None
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SYS-010** — Static Compile-Time Schedule

- **Description:** The FSW shall execute all applications on a static schedule fixed at compile time.
- **Rationale:** PM decision: no dynamic rate changes; deterministic TDM scheduling for repeatable nav and logging.
- **Verification Method:** Inspection
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** None
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SYS-011** — No Sensor Downsampling for Logging

- **Description:** The FSW shall log each sensor at its full sample rate without downsampling.
- **Rationale:** PM decision: preserve raw fidelity for post-flight analysis and Trick sim anchoring.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** None
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SYS-012** — Nav State Output Rate

- **Description:** The FSW shall publish navigation state estimates at 100 Hz during the mission.
- **Rationale:** PM-fixed nav output cadence supports telemetry, AFM, and consistent post-flight analysis.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** None
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SYS-013** — Sixteen-State Navigation Estimate

- **Description:** The FSW shall produce a navigation estimate containing position, velocity, attitude quaternion, and accelerometer and gyroscope biases.
- **Rationale:** PM-defined nav state composition: 3 position, 3 velocity, 4 quaternion, 3 accel bias, 3 gyro bias.
- **Verification Method:** Inspection
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** None
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SYS-014** — Navigation Position Bound to GPS

- **Description:** The FSW shall keep the navigation position estimate within a configured horizontal distance of the GPS fix.
- **Rationale:** PM-required black-box divergence sanity bound; numeric threshold lives in design, not requirement.
- **Verification Method:** Demonstration
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** None
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SYS-015** — Navigation Validity Flag

- **Description:** The FSW shall publish a navigation validity flag indicating whether the nav estimate is currently trustworthy.
- **Rationale:** PM-required observable state so consumers (telemetry, post-flight) can gate use of nav output.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** None
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SYS-016** — Automatic Flight Phase Detection

- **Description:** The FSW shall automatically detect boost, apogee, descent, and landing transitions from pre-launch initial phase.
- **Rationale:** PM-required AFM capability; pre-launch is the at-power-on initial phase per SW-REQ-AFM-002; algorithm choice deferred to design.
- **Verification Method:** Demonstration
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** None
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SYS-017** — Flight Phase Published to Software Bus

- **Description:** The FSW shall publish the current flight phase on the software bus.
- **Rationale:** PM decision: phase is an observable consumed by telemetry and logging via the bus.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** None
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

- **Description:** The FSW shall timestamp each flight phase transition within one second of post-flight ground-truth determination.

### **SW-REQ-SYS-062** — AFM-Loss Tolerance

- **Description:** The FSW shall continue executing applications at their static rates when flight phase detection is unavailable.
- **Rationale:** PM decision: loss of AFM does not halt the mission; apps run at static rates regardless.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** None
- **Children:** None
